visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged male with short black hair and silver-framed glasses wears a black collared shirt. He holds a small orange, carrot-shaped pointer in his right hand and a small black remote in his left. He stands in front of a digital animation of blue and white fireworks exploding against a dark night sky. A white text box with blue text is fixed at the top, and white subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) A screenshot of a scientific research paper from the journal 'Science Advances' is overlaid on the screen. The speaker points at the text while moving his mouth and maintaining a neutral expression. (3) The screen transitions to a grid of four photos showing brown, jagged fossilized bone fragments against a light background. Red arrows point to specific grooves and marks on the bones. The speaker remains visible in the lower portion of the frame, gesturing with the orange pointer. (4) A digital map or heatmap is displayed showing two diagrams labeled A and B. The diagrams use grayscale gradients to show the concentration of 'Fire artifacts' and 'Bones'. The speaker continues to explain, pointing at different sections of the diagram. (5) The speaker returns to a full head-and-shoulders view against the fireworks background. He uses expansive hand gestures to emphasize his points, looking directly into the camera. Yellow and white text boxes appear intermittently as subtitles and variety captions.
